faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Utkal Balashram Brahmapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Probation Officer cum Child Welfare Officer posts?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Probation Officer cum Child Welfare Officer post. However, the total number of vacancies across all posts in this recruitment drive is 9.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Utkal Balashram Brahmapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application for Utkal Balashram Brahmapur Recruitment 2026 is through email. Candidates need to send their applications and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Probation Officer cum Child Welfare Officer post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Probation Officer cum Child Welfare Officer post is Rs. 23170/- per month. Other posts have different salary scales as per the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Helper cum Night Watchman and Cook posts?
faq.answer: For the Helper cum Night Watchman and Cook posts, candidates need to have completed at least 8th grade and a maximum of 10th grade (Under Matric). Basic education is sufficient for these roles.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for Utkal Balashram Brahmapur Recruitment 2026 includes Career Marking, Merit List preparation, and Certificate Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Utkal Balashram Brahmapur?
faq.answer: The official website for Utkal Balashram Brahmapur, which is part of the Ganjam district administration, is www.ganjam.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information.
